jobs.description: The Bronze ledger's move with its lanes (root ADR-0616 A1b, A4; coordinator 2026-11-28; scripts/ops/bronze-ledger-export.sh, the publisher's export-bronze-ledger-rows): a source's ledger rows go with its collector, so for each Bronze source written by an AWS lane that holds a Lakekeeper table (config/lakekeeper-declaration.v1.json ledger_sources, generated from the pipeline graph) that has no export yet, its rows (source_catalog, ingestion_run, bronze_object, bronze_object_version, as to_jsonb, every timestamp kept) as one create-only gzip JSON Lines object, control/evidence/ledger_move/<date>-<source>.jsonl.gz. The AWS rollout imports every export into the AWS ledger before its services move (infra/aws/ledger-import.tf), so a load there plans from the history. It refuses, writing nothing, while a writer of the source runs or ran within two close intervals of the line writer, and a source whose objects carry rows elsewhere (members, measurements, publications). Partial: only sources without an export; `unchanged` once each has one. Started once after the deploy that turns the source's host writer off.
jobs.memory_measured: no run yet (new 2026-11-28, root ADR-0616 A4); sized as the publisher binary holding one source's ledger rows as JSON (85 rows for the industrial land sale notice's four sources on 2026-11-28, about 60 KB with their request parameters) and their gzip; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: A move, not a data producer: once each source has its export, `unchanged` is its normal outcome. That it keeps finishing is the done bound.
